surface.label: opencode (AGENTS.md + .agents/skills)
surface.readers: OpenCode v2, and AGENTS.md is also read natively by Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, Amp, Jules, Copilot CLI and the DeepSeek harness; Claude Code falls back to it, Antigravity and Gemini CLI accept GEMINI.md as an equal name
surface.verified: OpenCode v2 instructions and skills docs (opencode.ai/v2/docs, read 2026-10-14) — AGENTS.md only, combined from the workspace up to the project root; CLAUDE.md is not a fallback; skills at .opencode/skills/, .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, with the model shown name and description
surface.note: .agents/skills is one of the three skill locations opencode documents, so the same directory serves the standard surface without a symlink.

loader.label: OpenCode v2

start.why: OpenCode v2 instructions docs: every AGENTS.md from the workspace directory up to the project root is loaded and combined; V2 recognizes AGENTS.md only and does not fall back to CLAUDE.md
OpenCode v2 instructions docs: the global file is loaded first, before the project chain
OpenCode v2 skills docs: .claude/skills is a project compatibility source, registered before .agents/skills
OpenCode v2 skills docs: .agents/skills is a project compatibility source; the model is shown the id, name and description, not the body
OpenCode v2 skills docs: .opencode/skills is the project source and outranks .agents/skills and .claude/skills for the same id

alsoReads.why: OpenCode v2 instructions docs: instruction files below the workspace load when the agent reads or lists that area, not at session start
OpenCode v2 instructions docs: the config schema accepts an instructions array, but V2 does not resolve its files, globs or URLs

loader.order: global ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md, then project AGENTS.md files from the workspace directory up to the project root (nearest first); files are combined, not overridden
loader.capNote: no byte cap published for AGENTS.md; V2 accepts an instructions array and does not load it, so there is no fetch timeout to apply

imports.why: OpenCode v2 instructions docs: an AGENTS.md reference to another file is not an include; V2 loads AGENTS.md files by discovery, not by @path expansion

loader.nested: cumulative up to the project root at session start; files below the workspace load when that area is read

hooks.verified: OpenCode v2 plugins docs: direct .ts and .js files and immediate plugin packages are loaded from every discovered .opencode/plugins/ directory, and the plugins array in opencode.json(c)

agents.verified: OpenCode v2 agents docs (opencode.ai/v2/docs/agents, read 2026-10-30): subagents are markdown files with a description frontmatter under .opencode/agents/

mcp.verified: OpenCode v2 MCP servers docs (read 2026-10-14): servers are named under mcp.servers; V2 does not place server names directly under mcp

loader.verified: OpenCode v2 instructions, skills, plugins and MCP docs (opencode.ai/v2/docs, read 2026-10-14) — V2 loads AGENTS.md only, combining the global file with every project AGENTS.md from the workspace up to the project root; CLAUDE.md is not a fallback; the instructions array is accepted and not loaded; skills advertise name and description from .opencode/skills, .claude/skills and .agents/skills
loader.note: This row is OpenCode v2. V1 read CLAUDE.md when AGENTS.md was absent and loaded the instructions array; V2 does neither, so a meter that still did would bill bytes this reader does not pay.
